default.description: The Blog Aside component is a neatly organized section with a light background and rounded corners, giving it a clean and modern appearance. It features bold text for the author's name, followed by their role in a lighter font, and includes icons for contact information, date, and social sharing options. The overall design is minimalistic, with a focus on readability and easy access to meta information.

variants.difference: This variant of the Blog Aside component is taller and includes a profile image, adding a more personal touch. It features additional icons for social media sharing, enhancing interactivity. The layout remains clean, but the added elements provide more detailed meta information and engagement options.
